verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a built-in Bland AI that generates or improves prompts, pathways, or test cases from a description. The closest support is the first-party MCP server and plugin, which let an external AI coding agent build and validate pathways and run evals through natural language. The testbed supports iterating on prompts, but that editing is manual. Missing for 10: a native in-platform AI builder that turns a description into prompts or flows, AI-generated test cases or prompt-improvement suggestions, and independent corroboration.
